observations: Two remote fixed background windows pass, but they exclude lower-Y defects.
Full-width narrow bright lines and subsequent returns cross both sides of real oblique terrace/step at Y about-8nm and-23nm in F and B.
F rows231->232 quarter shifts about351..364pm; subsequent reverse about291..304pm. F rows158->159 about163..176pm.
Other low-Y grouped streaks intersect features.
mechanism: Junction/tip/feedback instability during scanning is supported; adsorbate or local surface contamination is a candidate, not uniquely established.
reason_to_condition: Persistent task-affecting cross-field offsets despite background stability; aim to reduce streaks and improve whole-frame reproducibility, not force all objects to one peak.
